description: This file defines the UpgraderController class, which extends AbstractInstallerVueController and manages the upgrade process screen for the OrangeHRM system. It sets up the upgrade component and updates the current screen state.

classes.name: UpgraderController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the upgrade process user interface in the OrangeHRM installation system.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the upgrade process screen by initializing the Component and setting the current screen state.
